script: Workers found an empty tank and a trail of wet prints leading to a drain. The missing resident was Inky, a clever octopus living at a New Zealand aquarium. Someone had left his tank lid just slightly open during the night. Inky slipped out, crossed the dry floor, and hunted for a way out. Because he had no bones except a tiny beak, he squeezed down a fifty-metre pipe and vanished back into the ocean, leaving only that trail behind. Comment if you think Inky made it home.

metadata.title: Random But True: The Octopus That Escaped
metadata.caption:
Workers at a New Zealand aquarium arrived to find an empty enclosure and a single trail of damp footprints leading straight to a floor drain.

Inky the octopus had taken advantage of an accidentally unlatched tank lid during the dead of night.

Lacking any bones besides a hard beak, his soft body slid across the dry floor and negotiated a fifty-meter drainage pipe that emptied directly into the open ocean.

Comment with your theory on how Inky survived the dry floor crossing.
